verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a GPU accelerator, not a service that holds a user's data in a vendor account. Exporting all of your data in open formats and leaving is a data-portability question for hosted products, so it does not apply to this kind of product. Open-source ROCm and Prometheus-format telemetry are about software openness and monitoring, not exporting user data, so they do not make this axis applicable.
